crossRefs.note: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown…
Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body…
He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all…
‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

translations.web: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
translations.bsb: You have granted me life and loving devotion, and Your care has preserved my spirit.
translations.kjv: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
translations.asv: Thou hast granted me life and lovingkindness; And thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
